import Mathlib

open Set

theorem r06 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hd : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hlip : ∀ a b, |deriv f a - deriv f b| ≤ L * |a - b|) (x y : ℝ) :
    f y ≤ f x + deriv f x * (y - x) + L / 2 * (y - x) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ,
      G = fun t => f t - f x - deriv f x * (t - x) - L / 2 * ((t - x) * (t - x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg : ∀ t, HasDerivAt G
      (deriv f t - deriv f x * 1 - L / 2 * (1 * (t - x) + (t - x) * 1)) t := by
    intro t
    have h1 := (hd t).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => s - x) 1 t := (hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const x
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s => (s - x) * (s - x)) (1 * (t - x) + (t - x) * 1) t :=
      h2.mul h2
    have h4 := ((h1.sub_const (f x)).sub (h2.const_mul (deriv f x))).sub (h3.const_mul (L / 2))
    rw [hG]
    exact h4
  have hGd : Differentiable ℝ G := fun t => (hg t).differentiableAt
  have h0 : G x = 0 := by simp only [hG]; ring
  have hy : G y = f y - (f x + deriv f x * (y - x) + L / 2 * (y - x) ^ 2) := by
    simp only [hG]; ring
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hxy
  · have hA : AntitoneOn G (Ici x) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ici x) hGd.continuous.continuousOn
        hGd.differentiableOn
      intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ici] at ht
      have ht' : x < t := ht
      rw [(hg t).deriv]
      have hl := hlip t x
      rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht')] at hl
      have := le_abs_self (deriv f t - deriv f x)
      linarith
    have key : G y ≤ G x := hA (mem_Ici.mpr le_rfl) (mem_Ici.mpr hxy) hxy
    linarith
  · have hM : MonotoneOn G (Iic x) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Iic x) hGd.continuous.continuousOn
        hGd.differentiableOn
      intro t ht
      rw [interior_Iic] at ht
      have ht' : t < x := ht
      rw [(hg t).deriv]
      have hl := hlip t x
      rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr ht')] at hl
      have := neg_abs_le (deriv f t - deriv f x)
      linarith
    have key : G y ≤ G x := hM (mem_Iic.mpr hxy) (mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl) hxy
    linarith

import Mathlib

open Set

theorem r07 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hf : StrongConvexOn univ m f) (hd : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (x : ℝ) (h0 : deriv f x = 0) (y : ℝ) : f x + m / 2 * (y - x) ^ 2 ≤ f y := by
  have heq : (fun z : ℝ => f z - m / 2 * z ^ 2) = fun z => f z - m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    funext z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hc : ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun z : ℝ => f z - m / 2 * z ^ 2) := by
    rw [heq]
    exact strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mp hf
  have h1 : HasDerivAt f 0 x := by
    rw [← h0]
    exact (hd x).hasDerivAt
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => f z - m / 2 * z ^ 2) (-(m * x)) x := by
    have h3 := h1.sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul (m / 2))
    have e : (0:ℝ) - m / 2 * (((2:ℕ):ℝ) * x ^ (2 - 1)) = -(m * x) := by
      rw [show (2:ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl, pow_one, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      ring
    exact h3.congr_deriv e
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | hxy | hxy
  · have h := hc.le_slope_of_hasDerivAt (mem_univ x) (mem_univ y) hxy hg
    simp only [slope_def_field] at h
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.2 hxy)] at h
    nlinarith [h]
  · subst hxy
    simp
  · have h := hc.slope_le_of_hasDerivAt (mem_univ y) (mem_univ x) hxy hg
    simp only [slope_def_field] at h
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.2 hxy)] at h
    nlinarith [h]

cases.solution:
import Mathlib

open Set

theorem r08 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (K : Set E) (hK : Convex ℝ K) (x y px py : E) (hpx : px ∈ K) (hpy : py ∈ K)
    (hx : ∀ z ∈ K, ‖x - px‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖) (hy : ∀ z ∈ K, ‖y - py‖ ≤ ‖y - z‖) :
    ‖px - py‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
  have hinf : ∀ (u v : E), v ∈ K → (∀ z ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ ≤ ‖u - z‖) →
      ‖u - v‖ = ⨅ w : K, ‖u - w‖ := by
    intro u v hv h
    haveI : Nonempty K := ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_ciInf (fun w => h w w.2)
    · have hb : BddBelow (Set.range fun w : K => ‖u - (w : E)‖) := by
        refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
        exact norm_nonneg _
      exact ciInf_le hb ⟨v, hv⟩
  have h1 := (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hK hpx).1 (hinf x px hpx hx) py hpy
  have h2 := (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hK hpy).1 (hinf y py hpy hy) px hpx
  have hxy : x - y = (x - px) - (y - py) + (px - py) := by abel
  have e0 : inner ℝ (x - y) (px - py) = inner ℝ (x - px) (px - py)
      - inner ℝ (y - py) (px - py) + ‖px - py‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hxy, inner_add_left, inner_sub_left (x - px) (y - py) (px - py),
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have e1 : inner ℝ (x - px) (px - py) = -inner ℝ (x - px) (py - px) := by
    rw [← inner_neg_right, neg_sub]
  have key : ‖px - py‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (x - y) (px - py) := by linarith
  have hle := real_inner_le_norm (x - y) (px - py)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (norm_nonneg (px - py)) with h | h
  · rw [← h]; exact norm_nonneg _
  · exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by nlinarith) h

cases.solution:
import Mathlib

open Set

lemma r09_descent {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hd : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hlip : ∀ a b, ‖gradient f a - gradient f b‖ ≤ L * ‖a - b‖) (x d : E) :
    f (x + d) ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) d + L / 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    f (x + t • d) - t * inner ℝ (gradient f x) d - L / 2 * t ^ 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2
  let φ' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    inner ℝ (gradient f (x + t • d)) d - inner ℝ (gradient f x) d - L * t * ‖d‖ ^ 2
  have hderiv : ∀ t, HasDerivAt φ (φ' t) t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • d) d t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const d).const_add x
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • d))
        (inner ℝ (gradient f (x + t • d)) d) t := by
      have := (hd (x + t • d)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
      rw [inner_gradient_left]
      exact this
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s * inner ℝ (gradient f x) d)
        (inner ℝ (gradient f x) d) t := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (inner ℝ (gradient f x) d)
    have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => L / 2 * s ^ 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2) (L * t * ‖d‖ ^ 2) t := by
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
        simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
      have := (hp.const_mul (L / 2)).mul_const (‖d‖ ^ 2)
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    exact (h2.sub h3).sub h4
  obtain ⟨c, hcm, hc⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope φ φ' (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)
    (fun t _ => (hderiv t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun t _ => hderiv t)
  have hc0 : 0 < c := hcm.1
  have hle : φ' c ≤ 0 := by
    have e1 : inner ℝ (gradient f (x + c • d)) d - inner ℝ (gradient f x) d
        = inner ℝ (gradient f (x + c • d) - gradient f x) d := (inner_sub_left _ _ _).symm
    have e2 := real_inner_le_norm (gradient f (x + c • d) - gradient f x) d
    have e3 := hlip (x + c • d) x
    have e4 : ‖x + c • d - x‖ = c * ‖d‖ := by
      rw [show x + c • d - x = c • d by abel, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc0.le]
    rw [e4] at e3
    have e5 : ‖gradient f (x + c • d) - gradient f x‖ * ‖d‖ ≤ L * (c * ‖d‖) * ‖d‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e3 (norm_nonneg _)
    show inner ℝ (gradient f (x + c • d)) d - inner ℝ (gradient f x) d - L * c * ‖d‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0
    nlinarith [e1, e2, e5]
  have hφ : φ 1 ≤ φ 0 := by
    rw [sub_zero, div_one] at hc
    linarith
  have h1 : φ 1 = f (x + d) - inner ℝ (gradient f x) d - L / 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
    show f (x + (1:ℝ) • d) - 1 * inner ℝ (gradient f x) d - L / 2 * 1 ^ 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2 = _
    rw [one_smul]
    ring
  have h0 : φ 0 = f x := by
    show f (x + (0:ℝ) • d) - 0 * inner ℝ (gradient f x) d - L / 2 * 0 ^ 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2 = f x
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
    ring
  rw [h1, h0] at hφ
  linarith

theorem r09 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hd : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hlip : ∀ a b, ‖gradient f a - gradient f b‖ ≤ L * ‖a - b‖) (x : E) :
    f (x - (1 / L) • gradient f x) ≤ f x - 1 / (2 * L) * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 := by
  have h := r09_descent f L hd hlip x (-((1 / L) • gradient f x))
  have hi : inner ℝ (gradient f x) (-((1 / L) • gradient f x)) = -(1 / L * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hn : ‖-((1 / L) • gradient f x)‖ ^ 2 = (1 / L) ^ 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hL)), mul_pow]
  have hx : x - (1 / L) • gradient f x = x + -((1 / L) • gradient f x) := sub_eq_add_neg _ _
  rw [hi, hn] at h
  rw [hx]
  have hinv : L * L⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hL.ne'
  have key : f x + -(1 / L * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) + L / 2 * ((1 / L) ^ 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2)
      = f x - 1 / (2 * L) * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 := by
    first
      | linear_combination (1 / 2 * L⁻¹ * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) * hinv
      | (field_simp; done)
      | (field_simp; ring1)
  linarith [h, key]

cases.solution:
import Mathlib

open Set

lemma r10_descent (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hd : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hlip : ∀ a b, |deriv f a - deriv f b| ≤ L * |a - b|) (x y : ℝ) :
    f y ≤ f x + deriv f x * (y - x) + L / 2 * ((y - x) * (y - x)) := by
  set h : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => f x + deriv f x * (y - x) + L / 2 * ((y - x) * (y - x)) - f y with hh
  have key : ∀ z, HasDerivAt h (deriv f x + L * (z - x) - deriv f z) z := by
    intro z
    have hs : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y - x) 1 z := (hasDerivAt_id' z).sub_const x
    exact ((((hs.const_mul (deriv f x)).const_add (f x)).add
      ((hs.mul hs).const_mul (L / 2))).sub (hd z).hasDerivAt).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hx0 : h x = 0 := by simp [hh]
  suffices 0 ≤ h y by simp only [hh] at this; linarith
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hxy
  · have hmono : MonotoneOn h (Ici x) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici x)
      · exact fun z _ => (key z).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · exact fun z _ => (key z).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · intro z hz
        rw [interior_Ici] at hz
        have hz' : x < z := hz
        rw [(key z).deriv]
        have h1 := hlip z x
        rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz')] at h1
        have h2 := le_abs_self (deriv f z - deriv f x)
        linarith
    have := hmono (left_mem_Ici) (show y ∈ Ici x from hxy) hxy
    linarith
  · have hanti : AntitoneOn h (Iic x) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Iic x)
      · exact fun z _ => (key z).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · exact fun z _ => (key z).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · intro z hz
        rw [interior_Iic] at hz
        have hz' : z < x := hz
        rw [(key z).deriv]
        have h1 := hlip x z
        rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz')] at h1
        have h2 := le_abs_self (deriv f x - deriv f z)
        linarith
    have := hanti (show y ∈ Iic x from hxy) right_mem_Iic hxy
    linarith

lemma r10_first (f : ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hf : StrongConvexOn univ m f) (hd : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (x z : ℝ) : f x + deriv f x * (z - x) + m / 2 * ((z - x) * (z - x)) ≤ f z := by
  have hc : ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun z => f z - m / 2 * (z * z)) := by
    refine (strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mp hf).congr ?_
    intro z _
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun z => f z - m / 2 * (z * z)) (deriv f x - m * x) x := by
    have := (hd x).hasDerivAt.sub (((hasDerivAt_id' x).mul (hasDerivAt_id' x)).const_mul (m / 2))
    exact this.congr_deriv (by ring)
  rcases lt_trichotomy x z with hxz | rfl | hxz
  · have h := hc.le_slope_of_hasDerivAt (mem_univ x) (mem_univ z) hxz hg
    rw [slope_def_field, le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hxz)] at h
    have h2 : (deriv f x - m * x) * (z - x) ≤ (f z - m / 2 * (z * z)) - (f x - m / 2 * (x * x)) := h
    nlinarith [h2]
  · simp
  · have h := hc.slope_le_of_hasDerivAt (mem_univ z) (mem_univ x) hxz hg
    rw [slope_def_field, div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hxz)] at h
    have h2 : (f x - m / 2 * (x * x)) - (f z - m / 2 * (z * z)) ≤ (deriv f x - m * x) * (x - z) := h
    nlinarith [h2]

theorem r10 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (m L : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmL : m ≤ L) (hf : StrongConvexOn univ m f)
    (hd : Differentiable ℝ f) (hlip : ∀ a b, |deriv f a - deriv f b| ≤ L * |a - b|)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = x k - 1 / L * deriv f (x k)) (xs : ℝ) (hmin : ∀ z, f xs ≤ f z) (k : ℕ) :
    f (x k) - f xs ≤ (1 - m / L) ^ k * (f (x 0) - f xs) := by
  have hL : 0 < L := lt_of_lt_of_le hm hmL
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m / L := by
    have : m / L ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hL).mpr hmL
    linarith
  -- PL inequality
  have hPL : ∀ y, 2 * m * (f y - f xs) ≤ (deriv f y) ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    have fo := r10_first f m hf hd y xs
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left fo (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * m)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m * (xs - y) + deriv f y)]
  have hstep : ∀ n, f (x (n + 1)) - f xs ≤ (1 - m / L) * (f (x n) - f xs) := by
    intro n
    have d := r10_descent f L hd hlip (x n) (x (n + 1))
    rw [hx n] at d
    have e : deriv f (x n) * (x n - 1 / L * deriv f (x n) - x n)
        + L / 2 * ((x n - 1 / L * deriv f (x n) - x n) * (x n - 1 / L * deriv f (x n) - x n))
        = - (deriv f (x n)) ^ 2 / (2 * L) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have d2 : f (x n - 1 / L * deriv f (x n)) ≤ f (x n) - (deriv f (x n)) ^ 2 / (2 * L) := by
      have : f (x n) - (deriv f (x n)) ^ 2 / (2 * L) = f (x n) + (- (deriv f (x n)) ^ 2 / (2 * L)) := by
        ring
      rw [this, ← e]
      linarith
    have hP := hPL (x n)
    have h3 : m * (f (x n) - f xs) / L ≤ (deriv f (x n)) ^ 2 / (2 * L) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hL (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hL.le]
    have eq : (1 - m / L) * (f (x n) - f xs) = (f (x n) - f xs) - m * (f (x n) - f xs) / L := by
      ring
    rw [eq, hx n]
    linarith
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc f (x (n + 1)) - f xs ≤ (1 - m / L) * (f (x n) - f xs) := hstep n
      _ ≤ (1 - m / L) * ((1 - m / L) ^ n * (f (x 0) - f xs)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hq
      _ = (1 - m / L) ^ (n + 1) * (f (x 0) - f xs) := by ring
